messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a single owners list for the pricing/packaging change implementation. Specifically: metering adapter, billing integration, quota enforcement, and contract/legal checks. Who's owning what?

sahil: I can take billing integration. I'll need the schema for the new rate card and the event contract from metering. Ping me when the PR lands.

maya: thanks @sahil. PR will be opened by EOD (rafi). Can you also confirm if billing needs any DB migration windows?

rafi: FYI opening the metering PR later today. No schema migrations for billing side — we emit usage events to kafka topic `usage.events.v2`. Billing just consumes.

kelly: For quota enforcement, product needs to sign off on edge cases (free-tier bursts, legacy contracts). I can own the contract/edge-case review but need legal to confirm mandatory clauses. ETA for product review: tomorrow noon.

maya: perfect. Legal contact is @sara-legal but she's out tomorrow. Kelly — can you draft the list of contract clauses we must check? quick bullets are fine.

kelly: will do. Draft will include: 1) grandfathered limits, 2) minimum commitment clauses, 3) metering latency impact on billing, 4) SLA credit calcs. I'll post in this thread.

sahil: re: billing integration — quick note: the consumer expects incremental counters in cents-per-unit. Example payload we need:```json
{"customer_id":"c-123","metric":"tokens","units":1024,"timestamp":1670000000} 
```Will confirm final fields in PR.

rafi: metering adapter config we plan to deploy:```yaml
topic: usage.events.v2
batch_size: 500
flush_interval_ms: 200
```This will affect peak latency by ~5-10ms at tail.

maya: callout: dedicated infra team flagged a GPU pool rollout next week that might cause transient backpressure on our observability pipeline — that could delay metering ingestion by a few minutes. That impacts billing for a small window. Should have mitigation: fallback to local disk buffering + surge replay.

rafi: adding local buffer is trivial, I'll add it to the PR.

kelly: product OK with a replay window as long as we document it in the contract appendices. I'll add that note to the draft.

maya: action items: sahil -> confirm billing consumer fields in PR; rafi -> open metering adapter PR w/ local buffer and perf notes; kelly -> draft contract clause list and post for legal; maya -> coordinate legal + infra and create one-pager for stakeholders.

maya: also, please add code review pings to the PR description like `@sahil @kelly @maya` so we can track. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for metering-adapter v2 to staging on 1765512000. No downtime expected.

rafi: noted, will make sure tests cover replay logic.

sahil: I'll review once PR shows up, likely tomorrow morning.

maya: thanks everyone — if anything blocks, drop a short update here.
